headline: Knowledge & RAG covers codebase memory, structure graphs and semantic search; the code clearly backs the three shipped graph/memory items, while the six remaining tickets — mostly GraphRAG, semantic similarity and knowledge-pack planning work — could not be confirmed from the code that was examined.
what_is_there: There is a working persistent memory of the codebase that indexes a repository into a knowledge graph and exposes it to the agent, plus generation of a codebase structure graph and an interactive browser-based graph viewer with zoom, filtering, search and click-through on nodes. Configuration for enabling and auto-indexing codebase memory is also in place.
what_is_unclear: The analysis saw no code touching knowledge-graph building from file content, semantic or embedding-based similarity search, portable knowledge pack formats, a shared context-collection layer for retrieval, or any measurement of search quality including Japanese-language evaluation. Only a keyword-selected slice of the repository was read, so this is an absence of evidence rather than evidence the work is missing.
suggested_action: Ask the team where the GraphRAG and semantic search components live and point the next review at those parts of the codebase, so the two in-progress tickets can be assessed properly.
